craft_notes: Sthāyin: parokṣa-dīkṣā unit 27. Sanskrit-first kept. Rows: 10. Close: rest. Rejected: smoothing — killed: flagged. Read aloud: steady cadence.

lines: When long broken apart, as two armies joined: again horse, elephant, man run towards their own caste by taste; by the nāḍī-wheels with the instrument-winds just so, joined, each with its own taste unified, by their own net subjugated.
l4.sanskrit_cite: ciravighaṭite senāyugmeyathāmilite punarhayagajanaraṃ svāṃ svāṃ jātiṃ rasādabhidhāvati karaṇapavanairnāḍīcakraistathaiva samāgatairnijanijarasādekībhāvyaṃ svajālavaśīkṛtaiḥ
